sourceTitle: A History of the Early Part of the Reign of James the Second
description: "A History of the Early Part of the Reign of James the Second" by Charles James Fox is a history written in the early 1800s. This Whig politician's unfinished work examines the first year of James II's reign in 1685, challenging Tory historian David Hume's interpretation.
